name: linkedin-ai-reply
description: A privacy-first Chrome Extension that learns your writing style and generates contextual AI reply suggestions for LinkedIn comments — powered by local Ollama or Gemini.

scripts.watch: node build.js --dev && echo 'Watching...' && node -e "require('fs').watch('content', {recursive:true}, () => require('child_process').exec('node build.js --dev'))"
